cs.label: [section] Požadavky na ukončení:
cs.content: Předmět je ukončen ústní nebo písemnou zkouškou. Podmínkou pro přihlášení ke zkoušce je zápočet, který je udělován za účast na povinné výuce (stanovená semestrální cvičení a všechny dny HC), prokázanou znalost při poznávání semen, druhu a stáří sadebního materiálu a odevzdání správně zpracovaných programů ze semestrálního cvičení (Zalesnění holiny, Kvalita sadebního materiálu) a hlavního cvičení.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Theoretical elucidation of principles and technological procedures, establishment of woody vegetation on different ecotopes.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.General principles of establishing woody vegetation (allowance 3/0) a.Establishing woody vegetation by natural and artificial methodsb.Establishing woody vegetation by plantingc.Establishing woody vegetation by sowingd.Spacing and density of plantationse.Creation of stand mixtures2.Legislative regulations for the establishment of woody vegetation (allowance 2/2) a.Reproductive material and its sourcesb.Essentials for the transfer of reproduction materialc.Gene pools3.Seed material for the establishment of woody vegetation (allowance 2/9) a.Collection and processing of seed raw materialb.Storage of seedsc.Recognition of seeds and fruits of forest trees and shrubsd.Determination of seed quality4.Planting stock for the establishment of woody vegetation (allowance 3/9) a.Planting stock and methods of its cultivationb.Planting stock cultivation by grafting and buddingc.Planting stock handling and transportationd.Recognition of species and planting stock agee.Evaluation of planting stock morphological and physiological quality5.Site preparation for the establishment of woody vegetation (allowance 2/0) a.Mechanical site preparationb.Chemical site preparationc.Biological site preparation6.Care of young plantations and crop (allowance 2/0) a.Minimization of game damagesb.Minimization of the negative impact of weedsc.Minimization of damages by biotic agents7.Establishment of woody vegetation on different ecotopes (allowance 8/4) a.Establishment of woody vegetation on dry, waterlogged and weed-infested sitesb.Establishment of woody vegetation in frost pockets and in alpine elevationsc.Establishment of woody vegetation in localities affected by air pollutiond.Establishment of woody vegetation with the use of agroforestry systeme.Project of clear-cut area reforestation8.Cultivation and use of grown-up trees (allowance 2/0)

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: The subject ends with the oral examination. Condition for the registration is credit, which is granted for attendance in compulsory lessons (semester tutorials and all days of the main tutorials), for demonstrated knowledge in the determination of seeds, planting stock type and age, and for the submission of correctly processed programmes from the semester tutorial (Clear-cut reforestation, Planting stock quality) and the main tutorial.
